cards.name: CC Blobbylize
cards.summary: Turns a channel of a blob layer (by default the layer itself, default channel Lightness) into soft, lit, liquid-metal or plastic-looking blobs with specular highlights. Cut Away removes low values so shapes melt into droplets.
use_for: liquid/melting logo or title reveals
chrome-blob stylised transitions in AI-explainer reels
organic morphing backgrounds behind text
abstract trailer interstitials
avoid: on a full-frame opaque photo with the Alpha property it only rounds the frame edges and re-lights the image, so it reads as a muddy emboss
high Softness on 4K layers is slow
left on the default Lightness channel over people it turns faces into glossy plastic blobs; never on serious news faces

Cut Away is a threshold on the softened channel: on bright footage (test_a Lightness barely dips below ~40%) Cut Away under ~50 removes nothing, so it only reads as a washed-out glossy soften; very high Softness (150+) averages the map toward mid-grey and flattens the relief. On footage use Cut Away ~55-65 with Softness 40-80, and keep Light Intensity ~100 or bright frames blow out

params.name: Blob Layer
params.does: layer whose channel defines the blob shapes (defaults to the layer itself)
params.typical: the text/logo or a fractal-noise precomp

params.name: Property
params.does: which channel of the blob layer drives the blobs (dropdown)
params.typical: 4 (Alpha) for text/logos; 6 (Lightness, default) or 5 (Luminance) for footage

params.name: Softness
params.does: how rounded and merged the blobs are

params.name: Cut Away
params.does: threshold that removes low values, splitting shapes into droplets
params.typical: 10-50 on alpha text/logos; 55-65 on footage Lightness

params.name: Light Intensity
params.does: strength of the effect light

params.name: Specular
params.does: strength of glossy highlights

params.name: Roughness
params.does: size of highlights; low = sharp chrome

params.name: Metal
params.does: how much highlights take the layer colour (metallic) versus white (plastic)

cards.scripting: Blob Layer is a layer-reference param: cannot be set from a spec, defaults to the layer itself (set it by hand or via ExtendScript layer index). Property: 1 Red, 2 Green, 3 Blue, 4 Alpha, 5 Luminance, 6 Lightness (default) (labels read from the CycoreFX HD 1.9.1 plugin binary). Using=2 (AE Lights) needs a light layer in the comp. Light Position is in layer pixels.

verified.note: Now reads unmistakably as Blobbylize: Cut Away 60 drops the dark clothing and foreground blocks out to black and the bright areas (stripes, a small round motif, block tops, backdrop, faces) melt into lit chrome blobs and droplets with sharp speculars, where the old render was only a brightened soften with no blobs or holes.
verified.second_opinion: corrected: agree weak (063 is a brightened soften, 45% of pixels >235 vs 5% in ref, no holes), but the 200/40 rewrite is still a no-op: source Lightness 5th pct is 0.37 and after Softness ~200 nothing is below 0.46, so Cut Away 40 cuts nothing and the extra Softness flattens the relief. Set Softness 50, Cut Away 60 (~35% of frame, the dark clothing/foreground blocks, drops out leaving lit blobs), Light Intensity 160->100, Ambient/Diffuse 60->50 to stop the blow-out; rewrote the avoid note and Cut Away typical to match

cards.name: CC Flo Motion
cards.summary: Pulls (positive Amount) or pushes (negative Amount) the image toward two knot points, creating liquid pinch and stretch distortion that can wrap around with tiled edges.
use_for: suck-into-a-point transition between shots
dreamy/trippy warp on a beat hit in reels
fake black-hole or portal pull in trailer titles
comic distortion of a meme still
avoid: large Amounts smear faces into mush, keep it brief on news footage
Tile Edges on visibly repeats the frame at the borders
even Amount 300 at Falloff 1 twists the whole 1080p frame into a tiled kaleidoscope spiral; use roughly 50-150 for a readable local pull

params.name: Knot 1
params.does: centre of the first pull/push point (comp pixels)
params.typical: on the subject or frame centre

params.name: Amount 1
params.does: pull strength at knot 1 (negative pushes out)

params.name: Knot 2
params.does: centre of the second point

params.name: Amount 2
params.does: pull strength at knot 2

params.name: Falloff
params.does: how quickly the distortion fades away from the knots

params.name: Tile Edges
params.does: checkbox: wrap pixels from the opposite edge instead of leaving gaps

params.name: Antialiasing
params.does: quality of the resampling

cards.scripting: Knot positions are layer-space pixels; harvested defaults sit at the 1/4 and 3/4 points of the layer. Finer Controls and Tile Edges are checkboxes (0/1). Antialiasing: 1 Low, 2 Medium, 3 High (labels read from the CycoreFX HD 1.9.1 plugin binary). Which sign pulls vs pushes is not verified; flip the sign if the warp goes the wrong way.

verified.note: Two strong vortex spirals form at both knots, pulling shrunken tiled copies of the frame (stripes, figures) into each centre; reads as a psychedelic liquid pull.

cards.name: CC Griddler
cards.summary: Cuts the image into a grid of square tiles and scales/rotates each tile around its own centre, giving a broken-screen / shrunk-tiles mosaic; at 100/100 scale and 0 rotation the image looks untouched.
use_for: glitchy tile break-up on a beat or transition in reels
video-wall / broken-monitor look behind a headline
stylised reveal where tiles resolve into the full image
avoid: tiny Tile Size on talking heads makes faces unreadable
static use looks like a cheap filter; animate it

params.name: Tile Size
params.does: size of each grid tile (percent of layer)

params.name: Horizontal Scale
params.does: horizontal scale of the image inside each tile

params.name: Vertical Scale
params.does: vertical scale of the image inside each tile

params.name: Rotation
params.does: rotation of the image inside each tile (degrees)

params.name: Cut Tiles
params.does: checkbox: crop content at tile edges for a clean grid

cards.scripting: Tile Size is roughly percent of layer height (render check: 12 gave ~130 px tile pitch on 1920x1080). Cut Tiles is a checkbox (0/1). Rotation has no harvested limits. To resolve into the clean image, end on Horizontal/Vertical Scale 100 and Rotation 0 (Tile Size alone never restores it).

verified.note: Frame is broken into a grid of shrunken, ~12 degree rotated square tiles separated by black gaps, a clear broken-screen mosaic.

cards.name: CC Lens
cards.summary: Bends the image through a lens that follows the layer's aspect (an oval on 16:9): positive Convergence bulges like a fisheye/magnifying glass, negative pinches; the area outside the lens drops out.
use_for: magnifying-glass zoom on a document detail in explainers
fisheye punch-in on a meme or reaction shot
crystal-ball / globe insert for titles
bulge transition on a beat
avoid: outside the lens circle goes transparent, so a small Size leaves a black frame unless something is underneath
faces in the bulge look comic; avoid on serious news

params.name: Center
params.does: centre of the lens (comp pixels)

params.name: Size
params.does: lens radius relative to the layer

params.name: Convergence
params.does: bulge (positive) or pinch (negative) strength

cards.scripting: Center is in layer pixels. Size is a percentage-like value (0-500); at default 50 much of the frame is outside the lens. Put it on a duplicate/precomp above the clean plate if the outside area must stay visible.

verified.note: Strong fisheye bulge inside a frame-filling oval lens, with the corners outside the lens transparent (black).

cards.name: CC Page Turn
cards.summary: Curls the layer like a turning book page from a corner, with a lit fold, a back side (paper colour or another layer) and transparency where the page has lifted away.
use_for: page-flip transition between newspaper clippings or archive documents
storybook chapter turns in documentaries
flip from one headline card to the next in news explainers
avoid: dated wedding-video feel if overused
flat lighting on the fold looks fake; keep Fold Radius moderate

params.name: Controls
params.does: which corner the page lifts from, or Classic UI (dropdown)
params.typical: 6 Bottom Right Corner (default); 3-5 other corners; 1 Classic UI; never 2 (separator)

params.name: Fold Position
params.does: in corner modes, where the lifted corner is dragged to; animate it across the frame to turn the page
params.typical: from a corner to beyond the opposite corner

params.name: Fold Direction
params.does: fold angle in degrees; drives the fold in Classic UI (corner modes are believed to derive it from the dragged corner)

params.name: Fold Radius
params.does: tightness of the curl

params.name: Render
params.does: which sides render (dropdown)

params.name: Back Opacity
params.does: opacity of the Back Page layer on the back of the curl; lower lets Paper Color show through
params.typical: 0-30 for a plain paper back, 85-100 to show the back layer

params.name: Paper Color
params.does: colour of the paper on the back of the curl (shows where Back Opacity is below 100)

cards.scripting: Back Page is a layer-reference param (defaults to the layer itself, seen mirrored on the back); cannot be set from a spec. Controls: 1 Classic UI, 2 separator (invalid), 3 Top Left, 4 Top Right, 5 Bottom Left, 6 Bottom Right Corner (default). Render: 1 Front & Back Page, 2 Back Page, 3 Front Page (labels read from the CycoreFX HD 1.9.1 plugin binary). Fold Position has no clamp, so off-frame values like [-600, -400] finish the turn from the bottom-right corner. Needs a layer underneath to show the revealed area.

verified.note: Bottom-right corner curls up like a page, showing the mirrored layer on the back of the fold and black where the page lifted away.

cards.name: CC Power Pin
cards.summary: Corner-pins the layer by its four corners with true perspective correction and optional edge expansion, so flat footage or graphics sit on a screen, sign or wall in the shot.
use_for: putting a clip or headline onto a TV, phone or laptop screen
placing a logo/poster on a wall or billboard in a press shot
3D-ish tilted cards for explainer graphics
faux-perspective floor or wall graphics
avoid: without tracking data the pinned layer floats on handheld footage
Perspective off (0) maps the texture without perspective, so a tilted screen insert looks bent across its diagonal

params.name: Top Left
params.does: top-left corner position (layer pixels)

params.name: Top Right
params.does: top-right corner position

params.name: Bottom Left
params.does: bottom-left corner position

params.name: Bottom Right
params.does: bottom-right corner position

params.name: Perspective
params.does: checkbox: perspective-correct texture mapping

params.name: Unstretch
params.does: checkbox: compensates texture stretching when the pinned shape differs strongly from the source (exact behaviour unverified)

params.name: Top
params.does: expands the pinned area beyond the top edge (percent); Left/Right/Bottom work the same

cards.scripting: Corners are layer-space pixels; for a layer smaller than the comp, convert comp points to layer space first. Expansion props sit under the Expansion (%) header and are addressed by their harvested bare names Top/Left/Right/Bottom. Perspective and Unstretch are checkboxes (0/1). Mocha/tracker data can be pasted into the four corners.

verified.note: Whole frame is corner-pinned into a tilted perspective quad with black around it, exactly as the four corner values describe.

cards.name: CC Ripple Pulse
cards.summary: Sends circular ripple rings out from a centre point; the ring profile is the history of Pulse Level over Time Span, so nothing appears unless Pulse Level is keyframed or driven by audio.
use_for: beat-synced ripple pulses on a reel (Pulse Level driven by audio amplitude)
shockwave on a bass hit or title slam in trailers
water-drop transition into a new shot
avoid: a constant Pulse Level renders no ripple at all (the plugin's own help: Pulse Level must be animated)
huge Amplitude tears faces and text apart

params.name: Center
params.does: origin of the ripples (comp pixels)

params.name: Pulse Level (Animate)
params.does: the driving value; ripples are emitted as it changes

params.name: Time Span (sec)
params.does: how long each pulse travels/lives

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: displacement strength of the ripples

params.name: Render Bump Map (RGBA)
params.does: checkbox: output the ripple height map instead of distorting

cards.scripting: Status needs_input: static values are a no-op, so it has no static demo. Keyframe Pulse Level (see recipe) with Amplitude 200-400 and Time Span 1-2 s, or expression-link Pulse Level to an Audio Amplitude slider for beat sync. Render Bump Map is a checkbox (0/1). Ring strength scaling vs Amplitude is not verified; start low.

verified.note: status needs_input: renders nothing on its own, so no frame was made

cards.name: CC Slant
cards.summary: Skews (shears) the layer sideways like italic type, optionally stretching it, setting its height and floor line, and filling it with a flat colour.
use_for: dynamic italic slant on title cards and lower thirds
speed-lean whoosh on text entering a reel
slanted colour bars/shapes for news graphics
flat colour silhouette shadows with Set Color
avoid: slanting live-action footage looks cheap and reveals edges
large Slant values push content out of frame

params.name: Slant
params.does: amount of horizontal shear

params.name: Stretching
params.does: checkbox: stretch the layer as it slants

params.name: Height
params.does: vertical scale of the slanted result (percent)

params.name: Floor
params.does: baseline point the slant pivots on (comp pixels)

params.name: Set Color
params.does: checkbox: fill the layer with Color

params.name: Color
params.does: fill colour when Set Color is on

cards.scripting: Floor is in layer pixels. Stretching and Set Color are checkboxes (0/1). Slant units are an internal amount, not degrees.

verified.note: Layer is sheared into a right-leaning parallelogram, slightly reduced in height, with black wedges at the left and top.

cards.name: CC Smear
cards.summary: Drags the pixels around a From point toward a To point, like smudging wet paint or a liquify push.
use_for: comic face/feature stretch in satire reels
smudge-wipe transition dragging the frame off
liquid pull on a logo for a reveal
avoid: using it on politicians' faces in news (not satire) reads as manipulation
big Radius with a long reach warps the whole frame into mush

params.name: From
params.does: point where the smear starts (comp pixels)

params.name: To
params.does: point the pixels are pulled to

params.name: Reach
params.does: how far along the From-To path the smear carries (percent)

params.name: Radius
params.does: size of the smeared area

params.name: Tip Type
params.does: shape profile of the smear tip (dropdown)
params.typical: 1 Classic (default); try 2 Round or 3 Bell for softer ends

cards.scripting: From/To are layer pixels. Tip Type: 1 Classic, 2 Round, 3 Bell, 4 Wizard (labels read from the CycoreFX HD 1.9.1 plugin binary). Stack several CC Smear instances for multiple strokes.

verified.note: Pixels around frame centre are dragged up-right into a smudged swoosh that stretches the stripes and the nearest face like wet paint.

cards.name: CC Split
cards.summary: Tears the image open along the line between Point A and Point B, pushing the two sides apart into a lens-shaped transparent gap.
use_for: crack-open reveal of the next shot or a headline underneath
transition where the frame splits open on a hit
'split' visual metaphor for party splits or divided opinions
avoid: the gap is transparent, so it shows black unless a layer sits below

params.name: Point A
params.does: one end of the split line (comp pixels)
params.typical: left edge or a quarter in

params.name: Point B
params.does: other end of the split line
params.typical: right edge or three quarters in

params.name: Split
params.does: how wide the gap opens

cards.scripting: Points are layer pixels. Split tops out at 250; if the gap does not clear the frame, also move Point A/B apart or scale the layer for a full exit.

verified.note: Frame is torn open along the horizontal A-B line into a large lens-shaped black gap pushing the top and bottom apart.

cards.name: CC Split 2
cards.summary: Like CC Split, but the two sides of the tear open by separate amounts, so the gap can be lopsided.
use_for: uneven tear-open reveal of the next shot
glitchy split hits on beats with different amounts per side
torn-poster style title reveals
avoid: transparent gap shows black without a layer underneath

params.name: Point A
params.does: one end of the split line (comp pixels)

params.name: Point B
params.does: other end of the split line

params.name: Split 1
params.does: opening on the first side of the line

params.name: Split 2
params.does: opening on the second side of the line

cards.scripting: Points are layer pixels. Verified render with A left of B: Split 1 opened the lower side (right-hand side walking from A to B) and Split 2 the upper side; swap the points to flip.

verified.note: Lopsided lens-shaped black tear: the lower side bows far open (Split 1 160) while the upper side opens much less (Split 2 50).

cards.name: CC Tiler
cards.summary: Shrinks the image and repeats it in a grid that fills the frame, like a wall of identical screens; can blend back with the original.
use_for: video-wall look for news montages or 'everyone is talking about it' beats
beat-hit tile-out in reels
patterned background from a logo or photo
zoom-out reveal from one frame to many
avoid: tiny tiles of live action become unreadable noise
identical tiles look cheap for long holds; keep it short

params.name: Scale
params.does: size of each tile (1 = 100 percent, one tile)

params.name: Center
params.does: anchor of the tile grid (comp pixels)

params.name: Blend w. Original
params.does: mix back toward the untiled image (0-1)

cards.scripting: Scale and Blend are raw 0-1 fractions in scripts (the UI shows percent). Center is layer pixels.

verified.note: Frame shrinks to a third and repeats as a clean 3x3 video-wall grid of identical copies.
